name: chromatika-ledger-live-network-stub
description: Stub for @ledgerhq/live-network. Replaces upstream via pnpm.overrides because (a) live-network's main module eagerly calls require('https') which crashes in MV3 service workers, and (b) chromatika never actually invokes its functions - it's pulled in transitively by @ledgerhq/ledger-trust-service + ledger-cal-service (themselves pulled by @ledgerhq/hw-app-sui via @mysten/ledgerjs-hw-app-sui), neither of which we call. See `wallet-extension/docs/STATUS.md` for context.
